Looking at where `label` is used in `JobCard` (line 756) and `CompletedJobCard` (line 627), the fix should be in `humanizeLabel` itself.

The simplest change: at line 756 and 627, use `job.description` first, truncated.


So I need to modify both places to check for `job.description` and truncate it to 70 characters if it's longer, falling back to the humanize functions only when there's no description available.
